title: Psalm 124 · second version
opening_line: Now Israèl may say, and that truly,

source.note: Received text from the official Free Church digital edition and plain-text archive.

text.diplomatic: Now Israèl may say, and that truly,
text.normalized: Now Israèl may say, and that truly,
text.reading: Now Israèl may say, and that truly,

text.diplomatic: If that the LORD had not our cause maintained;
text.normalized: If that the LORD had not our cause maintained;
text.reading: If that the LORD had not our cause maintained;

text.diplomatic: If that the LORD had not our right sustained,
text.normalized: If that the LORD had not our right sustained,
text.reading: If that the LORD had not our right sustained,

text.diplomatic: When cruel men against us furiously
text.normalized: When cruel men against us furiously
text.reading: When cruel men against us furiously

text.diplomatic: Rose up in wrath, to make of us their prey;
text.normalized: Rose up in wrath, to make of us their prey;
text.reading: Rose up in wrath, to make of us their prey;

text.diplomatic: Then certainly they had devoured us all,
text.normalized: Then certainly they had devoured us all,
text.reading: Then certainly they had devoured us all,

text.diplomatic: And swallowed quick, for ought that we could deem;
text.normalized: And swallowed quick, for ought that we could deem;
text.reading: And swallowed quick, for ought that we could deem;

text.diplomatic: Such was their rage, as we might well esteem.
text.normalized: Such was their rage, as we might well esteem.
text.reading: Such was their rage, as we might well esteem.

text.diplomatic: And as fierce floods before them all things drown,
text.normalized: And as fierce floods before them all things drown,
text.reading: And as fierce floods before them all things drown,

text.diplomatic: So had they brought our soul to death quite down.
text.normalized: So had they brought our soul to death quite down.
text.reading: So had they brought our soul to death quite down.

text.diplomatic: The raging streams, with their proud swelling waves,
text.normalized: The raging streams, with their proud swelling waves,
text.reading: The raging streams, with their proud swelling waves,

text.diplomatic: Had then our soul o’erwhelmèd in the deep.
text.normalized: Had then our soul o’erwhelmèd in the deep.
text.reading: Had then our soul o’erwhelmèd in the deep.

text.diplomatic: But blessed be GOD, who doth us safely keep,
text.normalized: But blessed be GOD, who doth us safely keep,
text.reading: But blessed be GOD, who doth us safely keep,

text.diplomatic: And hath not giv’n us for a living prey
text.normalized: And hath not giv’n us for a living prey
text.reading: And hath not giv’n us for a living prey

text.diplomatic: Unto their teeth, and bloody cruelty.
text.normalized: Unto their teeth, and bloody cruelty.
text.reading: Unto their teeth, and bloody cruelty.

text.diplomatic: Ev’n as a bird out of the fowler’s snare
text.normalized: Ev’n as a bird out of the fowler’s snare
text.reading: Ev’n as a bird out of the fowler’s snare

text.diplomatic: Escapes away, so is our soul set free:
text.normalized: Escapes away, so is our soul set free:
text.reading: Escapes away, so is our soul set free:

text.diplomatic: Broke are their nets, and thus escapèd we.
text.normalized: Broke are their nets, and thus escapèd we.
text.reading: Broke are their nets, and thus escapèd we.

text.diplomatic: Therefore our help is in the LORD’s great name,
text.normalized: Therefore our help is in the LORD’s great name,
text.reading: Therefore our help is in the LORD’s great name,

text.diplomatic: Who heav’n and earth by his great pow’r did frame.
text.normalized: Who heav’n and earth by his great pow’r did frame.
text.reading: Who heav’n and earth by his great pow’r did frame.
